visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a title screen featuring a gray fish character wiggling with a yellow headband. The background is white with faint orange 'LANLANCAT' brand pattern. (2) The fish character begins spinning rapidly like a horizontal drill, creating a blur effect with speed lines. (3) The character stands upright and holds a large red cartoon heart above its head with a happy expression. (4) The fish character performs a military-style salute with its right fin. Its eyes are wide and determined. (5) The fish develops an angry expression with narrowed eyes and a red vein symbol on its forehead. (6) The character stands on human-like legs and wiggles its body in a dance motion. (7) A large blue shark head enters from the right and bites down on the fish's torso. (8) The fish smiles, then its face quickly melts into a long, sad frown. (9) The character wears a cartoon crab shell and mask, looking through the eye holes. (10) A large orange cat paw holds the fish, and the fish retaliates by striking the paw with its tail. (11) The fish is wrapped in a blue patterned cloth and tip-toes across the frame looking suspicious. (12) The character lies flat, looking pale and sick with blue sweat drops. (13) The fish stares with one large eye, looking intensely skeptical. (14) Two cat paws squeeze the fish's face from both sides, making it bulge. (15) The fish claps its tail fins together with sparkling, wide eyes. (16) The character wears a blue cap and holds a heart while winking. (17) The fish is sliced vertically in half, revealing a red cross-section. (18) The character displays giant watery eyes and wiggles its tail pleadingly. (19) The fish lies in a blue cooler box on a bed of ice. (20) The fish character dives into a hole in the ground, leaving only its tail visible. (21) The character pops out of a silver can labeled 'Seafood' and dances. (22) The fish is tossed around in blue ocean waves looking dizzy. (23) The fish walks across the frame on legs carrying a huge red heart. (24) The character waves goodbye and smiles as the scene fades out.

(2) A mechanical spinning sound effect triggers, resembling a fast drill. (3) A light, melodic chime rings as a heart appears on screen. (4) A sharp 'swish' or 'whoosh' sound follows a rapid physical movement. (5) A distorted, low-pitched digital growl creates a brief sense of tension. (6) A rhythmic, squishy wiggling sound effect matches the character's body motion. (7) A cartoonish 'munch' sound plays as a bite action occurs. (8) A comical sliding whistle plays, moving up then down in pitch. (9) A metallic clink sound follows as a mask appears. (10) Percussive impact 'hit' sound effects are synchronized with physical strikes. (11) A series of 'boing' sounds play in a tip-toe sequence. (12) A comical deflating or sighing sound effect plays. (16) A 'sparkle' chime effect plays as the character winks. (17) A sharp, metallic 'slash' sound effect occurs during a cut action. (18) A soft, gentle melodic phrase plays during a pleading expression. (19) A sliding metal sound plays as a box opens. (20) A dull 'thud' followed by dirt-rustling sounds plays. (21) A metallic 'pop' sound resembles a can opening. (22) A splashing water sound effect is layered over the BGM. (23) Cartoonish walking footstep thuds accompany rhythmic movement. (24) A final friendly pop sound effect ends the sequence as the BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional showcase for a new set of animated stickers on the LINE messaging platform. It features the 'Mochi Dad' fish character in various humorous and emotive poses to demonstrate the sticker set's personality and encourage viewers to purchase the pack.
